## Synthesis incomplete

All 3 runs reported themselves as partial (each ended with an "Audit incomplete" section), so the absence of findings does not show the corpus is accurate. Union of what the runs checked and found matching source:

- Orchestrator environment variables against `.env.example`, both directions (runs 1, 2, 3)
- Admin API routes against `reference/admin-ui.mdx` (runs 2, 3)
- `RepoMapping` fields against `configuration/team-repo-mappings.mdx` (runs 1, 3)
- Skills catalog and names (runs 1, 2, 3)
- Session lifetime, `/trigger/gap-fill`, `autoMerge` and `autoApprovePlans` claims, Jira statuses (various runs)
- Knowledge-graph tools against `reference/mcp-tools.mdx` (run 3)

Not reached by any run:

- Pipeline steps and post-push-review pages
- Feature-branch grouping reference
- Notification payloads and the notifications reference
- Run-status and error-code references
- Target-repo workflow variable header blocks in `ai-implement/workflows/`
- Per-repo `.ai-implement/config.yml` keys
- Per-skill behavior against individual `SKILL.md` files
- Setup guides and troubleshooting remediations
- Value-by-value per-field defaults in the mapping docs
